Subject: Request: short evidence onramp & pen-test orientation

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the help so far — Finocorp is moving toward a production integration and we need a short "evidence onramp" call to:
- review Redwood's SOC 2 scope and evidence locations,
- confirm pen-test vendor onboarding and timeline, and
- run through DPA redlines at a high level so procurement can prepare.

Can your team do a 45–60 minute session next week? We're US-based (PST) but will include a couple of folks in London who can join early evening PST. Proposed windows:
- Tue 2026-12-07: 10:00–11:00 PST or 16:00–17:00 PST
- Wed 2026-12-08: 09:00–10:00 PST

If none of those work, please propose a couple of alternatives. Also, can you confirm: do you have an SOC 2 summary we can review ahead of time, and do you have a preferred pen-test vendor or should we propose ours?

Thanks,
Sydney Harris
Security Program Manager, Finocorp
Sydney Harris | Finocorp

Hi Sydney — great to hear from you. Happy to run the onramp call. Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: attaching a 2-page summary and scope map (see attachment).
- Pen-test: we can either coordinate with your vendor or provide our preferred vendor list; for speed, if you have a vendor ready, please share their contact and expected testing window.
- DPA: we have an annotated DPA (redlines) we can share ahead of time and will surface the procurement owner on the call.

Those windows mostly work for us; we recommend Tue 2026-12-07 16:00–17:00 PST since it catches the London folks at a reasonable hour. Proposed agenda (45 min):
1) 5 min — introductions & objectives
2) 15 min — SOC 2 scope + where evidence lives
3) 10 min — pen-test onboarding & scope (who owns what)
4) 10 min — DPA redline highlights & procurement next steps
5) 5 min — actions and owners

If that fits, we'll send a calendar invite and upload the attachments to the shared Drive link.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2026Q3.pdf; pen-test-scope-draft.docx

—
